description: Credential-safety gate for ai-platform-kit. On every Bash and Read tool call, blocks reads of credential and state files (.databrickscfg, .aws/credentials, cloud tokens, *.tfstate, *.tfvars). Resolved via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so the guardrail is delivered when the kit is installed as a plugin, not just when Claude Code runs from the repo. Rationale: SECURITY.md.
